name: Waypoint, Patched
tagline: The flight console patched through: the Next up tube beside the route with a short lit lead into the row it reports, a vertical readout, and every list on its numeral law.
concept: Waypoint, Ruled patched where every judge docked it, with the instrument kept whole. The Next up tube stands in Coming up's empty right column (24rem, an 8rem radar, near-black glass, its case's power light lit), and a short straight phosphor patch lead runs from a socket at the end of the Next row's words into a steel socket on the case: light wired to the row it reports. The readout is a vertical annunciator stack sharing the greeting's top and the starters' foot, each figure a link; on a phone the next plan comes lit straight after the box. Ideas is a one-column flight log, nearest first, with by-road figures on the numeral law and a heading chevron turned to the real bearing; the month draws its route once, full width, above a grid that only rings its days. One rule holds everywhere: the filled jewel is Now and today, Next is always the lit ring. Light runs only along the path from Now to Next; every hover is a steel afterglow.
companions: Bone (#d9d2bb) for every figure that counts, its lead (#b9b29c) for labels, leaders, the rule heads' bar and every pictogram (her screen on Settings included); route bone (#c4c2b4) for rings and the plan chips' bar; steel (#6f8596, cap #a9c4d8) for here, every hover afterglow, latched keys, the setup lamp and the tube's socket; sage (#8fae86) for a settings part that is set up, as a tick; amber (#e3a651) only for late, as the triangle and words; the kind tokens (clay, wheat, sage, steel-cyan, lilac, rose, mulberry) as 3px bars and tinted kind words in place of the confetti squares.
